findings.obligation: One owner per fact; comments say the truth (nw-code-craftsmanship SSOT, project comment rule). Severity low.
findings.observation: The script comment says: '# Both are set here, not in the image, so other jobs on this runner keep OpenSSL's stock behaviour.' but the Dockerfile sets 'ENV PKCS11_PROVIDER_MODULE=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opensc-pkcs11.so' in the image, and the same path is repeated at sign-windows.sh:14 'opensc_module=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opensc-pkcs11.so'. The comment is wrong for one of the two variables, and the module path has two owners.
findings.remediation: Reword the comment to say only OPENSSL_CONF is set here and the module variable comes from the image, or drop the ENV; derive opensc_module from PKCS11_PROVIDER_MODULE so the path has one owner.

findings.obligation: PIN never exposed beyond the minimum (secret handling hunt). Severity low.
findings.observation: The line 'if ! printf '%s' "$YUBI_PIN" | osslsigncode sign \' keeps YUBI_PIN exported in the environment of osslsigncode, pkill and sudo children, where /proc/<pid>/environ holds it for the whole signing run. The PIN is not on argv or in output, so this is hardening, not a defect.
findings.remediation: Copy the PIN to a local variable at start and unset YUBI_PIN, or run osslsigncode with 'env -u YUBI_PIN'.

findings.obligation: Required check cannot move latest backwards (publish safety). Severity low.
findings.observation: The publish job ('publish:' with 'needs: verify') has no concurrency group, so a weekly run and a main push can publish at once and the slower one moves latest to the older commit tag at 'docker buildx imagetools create --tag "$LATEST_TAG" "$COMMIT_TAG"'.
findings.remediation: Add a top-level or publish-job 'concurrency: group: codesign-runner-publish' with cancel-in-progress false.

findings.obligation: Truthful readiness: what keeps the machine current between reboots. Severity low.
findings.observation: README lists '[watchtower](https://containrrr.dev/watchtower/), run regularly' as a prerequisite, but no file in the candidate installs or schedules it; only the unit's boot-time pull is delivered.
findings.remediation: Say plainly that updating between reboots is a manual or maintainer-owned step, or ship a timer; record it as a residual item for EXAMINE.
